info.title: GMIB management API
info.description: Current stable `/api` router contract. Dynamic plugin APIs, WebSocket/static surfaces, and conditionally mounted NovaStar APIs are intentionally outside this document. Request schemas describe accepted fields, but legacy CRUD handlers do not uniformly validate JSON at runtime.

get.description: The client id is ASCII letters, digits, `_` or `-`, at most 128 characters. A pending handshake expires after 10 seconds.

post.description: Submit SRP public value A and proof M1 for an unused handshake. Verify returned M2 before retaining the session key. `salt` and `verifier` are rejected here; use password rotation.

put.description: Always requires normal Bearer or HMAC authentication, including legacy unsafeMode. Send a newly derived salt/verifier pair, never a password. Successful rotation revokes all pending and incoming remote sessions and returns `reauthenticateRequired`.

get.description: Requires the plugins license capability in addition to the normal API authentication.
The catalog is read through the same authenticated, plugins-capability-gated management router.

Requires normal authentication, including unsafeMode. The response is an allowlisted projection; private config and secrets are never returned. Curves are read back with configSchema defaults when absent.

patch.description: Requires normal authentication and an active license for a mutation, including unsafeMode. Omitted fields are preserved. `dryRun=true` validates and previews the canonical readback without persistence or config broadcast. `spline:null` and `sunSpline:null` reset to configSchema defaults; location and nightMode null clear those optional fields.

get.summary: Read saved and passively discovered GMIB endpoints
get.description: Requires normal authentication, including unsafeMode. Saved and mDNS-discovered endpoints are returned separately. The revision covers only the normalized saved list, so discovery churn does not invalidate an update. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

put.summary: Replace the complete saved GMIB endpoint list
put.description: Requires normal authentication and an active license, including unsafeMode. The signed JSON body must contain the revision from GET and the complete desired saved list. A stale revision returns 412. `dryRun=true` validates and predicts the resulting revision and normalized saved list without persistence. The predicted revision becomes current only if the same replacement is later applied against an unchanged base revision.

412.description: The saved list changed after the supplied revision was read.

post.description: Multipart upload. The server reports per-file conversion failures with 207; its HMAC timestamp allowance is six hours.

put.description: Replacement update: send the full playlist and its complete items array.

patch.description: Legacy item-only mutation. Exactly one of `insert` or `remove` is meaningful; other shapes currently leave items unchanged.

post.description: Create persists the fields in `CreateScreen`. `addresses` is not persisted on POST. `brightness` is unsupported on POST and a defined value may fail the current SQL binding; omit both fields, read the created screen back, and use PUT with its id to set them.

put.description: Replacement update: absent address list clears existing addresses.

get.description: Cron schedules use GMIB host local time; there is no timezone field. See the input schema for action-specific fields and legacy validation limits.

post.description: Creates a scheduler record. The legacy runtime persists bodies without complete upfront validation; schema-required scheduling and action fields are required for a runnable job and can otherwise fail only at execution.

put.description: Replacement update. The path id wins over any body id. The legacy runtime persists bodies without complete upfront validation; schema-required scheduling and action fields are required for a runnable job and can otherwise fail only at execution.

Legacy `announce` and `iv` values may be present; do not use them as a new activation contract. A client with an HMAC session may send `x-ni-license-session-challenge` to receive a license-session assertion.

post.description: Allowed before activation. Success initiates relaunch; send the license key in protected JSON input, never an argv value.
Allowed before activation; may schedule relaunch after success.

put.description: Replacement update: path id overrides any body id.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Unix epoch milliseconds; absent or invalid defaults to the previous 24 hours.

LocalBearer.description: Local runtime credential; never expose it to a remote client.

HmacSignature.name: x-ni-signature
HmacSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 of METHOD + PATH_AND_QUERY + TIMESTAMP + BODY using SRP session key. See scripts/gmib-api-client.mjs.

PluginPermissionsQuery.name: permissions
PluginPermissionsQuery.description: Comma-separated exact permission list accepted by the plugin manifest.

SplineSetting.description: Lux values must be strictly increasing and brightness values must not decrease.

NightBrightnessModePatch.description: When creating nightMode, start, end and brightness are all required after merging; an existing complete mode can be patched one field at a time.

key.description: Normalized address and NiBUS port endpoint key; this is not a stable device identity. IPv6 keys use brackets.

address.description: IPv4, IPv6 (optionally bracketed), or hostname. URL syntax, scoped IPv6, whitespace, and abbreviated or encoded IPv4 forms are rejected.

revision.description: Deterministic revision of normalized saved endpoints only.

CronSchedule.description: Six-part schedule interpreted in the GMIB host local timezone. Selected values are sorted and deduplicated on persistence; the runtime does not range-validate them. Legacy stored five-part schedules read back with seconds set to `{ mode: "select", every: 1, selected: [0] }`.

SchedulerBase.description: Scheduler response fields. Execution state and nextRunAt are server-generated.

SchedulerJobInputBase.description: Input for a runnable scheduler job. `id` is optional only for legacy POST clients and is generated when omitted; PUT always uses the path id. `runAt` and cron date components are parsed by JavaScript on the GMIB host; send an ISO timestamp with an explicit offset for once jobs. No timezone property exists for cron jobs, which use host local time. Priority is truncated to an integer and cron selected arrays are sorted and deduplicated on persistence.

id.description: Optional legacy POST id; ignored by PUT.

allOf.description: For `load-playlist`, playlistId is required. `play-item` defaults itemNumber to 1; stop and output flags are optional. The runtime enforces these action prerequisites when executing, not necessarily while creating the legacy record.

show-test needs screenId and testId; hide-test needs screenId; set-brightness needs brightness; set-autobrightness and set-overheat-protection need enabledValue. The runtime enforces these action prerequisites when executing, not necessarily while creating the legacy record.

license.description: Signed license document; opaque to callers.

key.description: Machine id; do not treat as a license key.

EmptySuccess.description: Completed; runtime may return an empty 200 response.

PluginForbidden.description: The request is authenticated but the plugins license capability is unavailable. This lifecycle router is mounted before the general license gate and returns a structured JSON capability error.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The plugin archive exceeds the 50 MiB upload limit.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The archive upload must use application/octet-stream.

PluginInstallResult.description: Install result. A changed archive or enabled state can require a restart.

PlainTextBadRequest.description: Invalid request. This legacy branch uses Express sendStatus(400), so the body is the standard plain-text status message.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication failed; general middleware returns `{ identifier }` for a new SRP attempt.

ForbiddenLicense.description: Requires an active license; body is plain text.

LicenseRequired.description: Requires an active license; body is plain text.

PlainTextConflict.description: License retry did not obtain an active license; the runtime sends its message as plain text.

ServerError.description: Runtime failed; body may be plain text.

SrpRotationFailure.description: `rotation_failed` leaves old credentials active; `revocation_incomplete` means new credentials were stored and callers must reauthenticate.
